options.name: Trading agent asks Jev before a paper order
options.blurb: The agent assembles order + thesis + today's headlines and calls ask_jev: is the thesis supported, does any headline contradict it, how risky is it? Code decides proceed / revise / block.

risk.instructions: How risky is `order` given the news?

outputs.meaning: would send the plan back to the agent to revise
rejected in code before any Jev call (non NYSE/Nasdaq venue, future data, or bad input)

options.jev_calls: 1 call per ask_jev; the agent decides when to call (budget: 30 calls, $0.05)

venue.description: NYSE or NASDAQ; anything else is rejected in code

headlines: Main MI400 customer switches to NVIDIA

options.name: Post-trade journal review
options.blurb: After a paper trade closes the agent asks: did I follow the plan, and what was the main mistake? Code tags the journal entry; repeated mistakes feed the rules.

mistake.instructions: What was the main mistake, if any?

outputs.meaning: rejected in code before any Jev call (non NYSE/Nasdaq venue, future data, or bad input)

options.jev_calls: 1 call per ask_jev; the agent decides when to call (budget: 30 calls, $0.05)

inputs.what_happened: Bought 130, moved stop to 110 when it dipped, lost 2R
Bought 300 shares because I felt sure
Sold at 132 on the first red candle
Cancelled the stop, held through the gap
Market bought at 236 at the open

options.name: Triage a failed backtest run
options.blurb: The research agent runs the backtest through ask_jev (command + captured output) and gets the failure classified before touching code. Lookahead bias always goes to a human.

kind.instructions: What kind of failure does `output` show?

criteria.lookahead: Future data leaked into the backtest

outputs.meaning: agent fixes in an isolated branch (no merge)
rejected in code before any Jev call (non NYSE/Nasdaq venue, future data, or bad input)

options.jev_calls: 1 call per ask_jev; the agent decides when to call (budget: 30 calls, $0.05)

inputs.output: NameError: name 'ema_fast' is not defined. Did you mean 'fast_ema'?
AssertionError: signal at 2025-03-04 uses close of 2025-03-05
ConnectionResetError while fetching bars; retry 3/3 failed
Sharpe 9.1 with 0 losing trades over 5 years; fills at the high of every bar
assert 19 == 20: rolling window off by one in features.py line 42

options.name: Judge a strategy diff before promotion
options.blurb: The coding agent changed a strategy; it puts git diff through ask_jev for a risk score and a review call. Any diff touching risk/ or orders/ needs a human in code. Never auto-promotes.

risk.instructions: How risky is `diff` for live behaviour of the strategy?

needs_review.instructions: Should a human review `diff` before it runs even in paper?

outputs.meaning: would run in the paper forward test only
rejected in code before any Jev call (non NYSE/Nasdaq venue, future data, or bad input)

options.jev_calls: 1 call per ask_jev; the agent decides when to call (budget: 30 calls, $0.05)

options.name: Classify a desk request, gate the plan
options.blurb: A PM request arrives; the agent asks Jev: config change, code change, or a decision a human owns? And is it clear enough to plan? Code acts accordingly.

criteria.human: A product/risk decision a person owns

clear.instructions: Is `request` clear enough to plan without a question?

outputs.meaning: would escalate to the PM/risk owner
would draft a config change for review
would draft a code change in an isolated branch
